verses.en: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.pt: A palavra do Senhor que veio a Jeremias, o profeta, acerca dos filisteus, antes que Faraó ferisse a Gaza.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet about the Philistines, before Pharaoh's attack on Gaza.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que do Norte se levantam as águas, e tornar-se-ão em torrente trasbordante, e alagarão a terra e quanto há nela, a cidade e os que nela habitam; os homens clamarão, e todos os habitantes da terra uivarão,
verses.en_web: Yahweh says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: See, waters are coming up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, overflowing the land and everything in it, the town and those who are living in it; and men will give a cry, and all the people of the land will be crying out in pain.

verses.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.pt: ao ruído estrepitoso das unhas dos seus fortes cavalos, ao barulho de seus carros, ao estrondo das suas rodas; os pais não atendem aos filhos, por causa da fraqueza das mãos,
verses.en_web: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.en_bbe: At the noise of the stamping of the feet of his war-horses, at the rushing of his carriages and the thunder of his wheels, fathers will give no thought to their children, because their hands are feeble;

verses.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.pt: por causa do dia que vem para destruir a todos os filisteus, para cortar de Tiro e de Sidom todo o resto que os socorra; pois o Senhor destruirá os filisteus, o resto da ilha de Caftor.
verses.en_web: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the day which is coming with destruction on all the Philistines, cutting off from Tyre and Zidon the last of their helpers: for the Lord will send destruction on the Philistines, the rest of the sea-land of Caphtor.

verses.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.pt: A calvicie é vinda sobre Gaza; foi desarraigada Asquelom, bem como o resto do seu vale; até quando te sarjarás?
verses.en_web: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?
verses.en_bbe: The hair is cut off from the head of Gaza; Ashkelon has come to nothing; the last of the Anakim are deeply wounding themselves.

verses.en: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.pt: Ah espada do Senhor! até quando deixarás de repousar? volta para a tua bainha; descansa, e aquieta-te.
verses.en_web: “‘You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’
verses.en_bbe: O sword of the Lord, how long will you have no rest? put yourself back into your cover; be at peace, be quiet.

verses.en: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
verses.pt: Como podes estar quieta, se o Senhor te deu uma ordem? Contra Asquelom, e contra o litoral, é que ele a enviou.
verses.en_web: “How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.”
verses.en_bbe: How is it possible for it to be quiet, seeing that the Lord has given it orders? against Ashkelon and against the sea-land he has given it directions.
